test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which is NOT correct about the Election Commissioners of Election Commission of India?

options.text: They hold a six-year term or continue till the age of 65, whichever is earlier.
They are appointed by the President of India
The CEC enjoys more powers than the other two Election Commissioners.
The Election Commission is a multi-member body consisting of a Chief Election Commissioner and two other Election Commissioners.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The CEC enjoys more powers than the other two Election Commissioners.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Election Commission of India is a constitutional structure. **
 
• It was started by the Constitution of India to** manage and control elections in the country.**
 
• **Article 324** of the Constitution gives that the power of superintendence, **direction, and authority of elections to parliament, state legislatures, the office of the president of India, and the office of vice-president of India shall be implied in the election commission.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• They hold a six-year term or carry on till the **age of 65**, whichever is earlier.
 
• They are scheduled by the **President of India.**
 
• The Election Commission is a **multi-member body consisting of a Chief Election Commissioner and two other Election Commissioners.​ **
